title: Dripping / flowing
recognition: Gravity-aligned flowing patterns, often extending vertically.

confused_with.difference: Flowing is gravity-aligned streaking; breaking is thinning / colour change over raised ridges.
Not every drip is a defect: call it running only with clear excessive accumulation.
